PDF rendering of the Master List slip for [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 4)]], front face. It prints the PC-E4 game text (official text as of 27 April 2013), word for word the release-sheet text. The Master List slip prints no slip number (only the errata mark E).
